risks.reasoning: For the three months ended March 31, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash used in operating activities of RMB12,605 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB198,315 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately RMB4,202 thousand and cash runway is approximately 47.20 months, above the 12-month trigger.

The accountants' report shows profit and total comprehensive income for the year/period of RMB41,879 thousand, RMB60,252 thousand, RMB71,719 thousand, RMB9,186 thousand and RMB38,205 thousand for 2019, 2020, 2021, 3M2021 and 3M2022 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods.

Revenue increased from RMB138,749 thousand in 3M2021 to RMB228,869 thousand in 3M2022, an increase of approximately 64.95%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For 3M2022, the largest customer accounted for approximately 7.5% and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 30.7% of revenue. The top-five ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30%, triggering a medium concentration risk.

For 3M2022, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 14.8% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 54.2% of cost of revenue. The top-five ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30%, triggering a medium concentration risk.

The Pre-IPO Investors were granted special rights including redemption rights in relation to Ophyer Technology. The rights were terminated before or immediately before the listing application but will only revive if the application is withdrawn, expired or cancelled. Because the termination is conditional and the redemption rights remain restorable, the risk is left as needs_review.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Compliance section states that the Group had not been involved in any actual or pending litigation, arbitration or administrative proceedings believed to have a material adverse impact during the Track Record Period and up to the Latest Practicable Date, and that it complied with applicable PRC laws and regulations in all material respects. No material pending matter was identified.

The Group is an established AR/VR content and services provider with substantial revenue from AR/VR marketing services, AR/VR content, AR/VR SaaS and other businesses throughout the Track Record Period. Its core products and services are fully commercialized and revenue-generating.
